regions.merged_text: I hope you are well. I quite enjoyed your letter when I read it on Nov. 17 and again This A.M. when it came to my notice. Also did enjoy your dear Dad's discription of your trips to Burkhardt. Sorry he left out all about old Trimbelle. No doubt I ought to re- mind him as he proposed to continue ..... God bless you and yours. Mary is well; drops in or phones occasionally.
